column1: # size budget (docs/README.md, "Size budget"), tracked by scripts/check-docs.sh.
# Format: path<TAB>bytes<TAB>issue — `bytes` is the most this file may be;
# `issue` is the GitHub issue (bare number) that will bring it under budget.
# Entries may only shrink (a falling byte count, or a removed line); never
# add slack by raising one. Each figure is the file's size in this tree, so a
# file whose growth this repository's own conventions require — a requirement
# added to an as-built specification, a configuration key regenerating
# README.md's tables — has no headroom here and fails the check; #2163 tracks
# that collision and how to resolve it.
